Rawai at a glance

Our catalogue currently lists 10 development projects in Rawai: 2 villas, 2 townhouses, 6 condominiums. Advertised starting prices run from ฿3,700,000 to ฿22,327,200 (10 of 10 projects publish a price; the rest are on request). Ownership offered by the developers: freehold and leasehold, so please confirm the exact title with your lawyer before buying.

About Rawai

Rawai is at the southern end of Phuket, in Mueang Phuket district, between Nai Harn and Chalong. Rawai Beach and its pier, the Nai Harn and Ya Nui beaches, and several international schools appear in the project data for this area; distances are listed under nearby places below.

The projects we list here include condominiums close to Rawai Beach, pool villas and a townhouse project. It is the southernmost of the areas in our catalogue, so check the travel time to the airport and to the west-coast beaches in the nearby-places data before you decide.

Neighbouring areas in our catalogue: Kata
